description: The article's data-collection instrument is a testing method applied to five street-vendor children (four boys and one girl, aged 9-15, mean 11.2, grades one to eight).
title: Hybrid clinical-interview-plus-participant-observation method

description: A hybrid discourse-classification system developed and validated by the authors to connect micro-level discourse patterns with macro-level learning outcomes.
title: Hybrid confidence-aware NLP–LLM annotation workflow for learning discourse

description: The framework treats LLM grading unreliability as arising from two sources: epistemic uncertainty, estimated from model-based signals (verbalized, latent, and consistency-based confidence), and aleatoric uncertainty, estimated from the dataset.
title: Hybrid confidence framework integrating model-based confidence with dataset-derived aleatoric uncertainty via semantic heterogeneity

description: A reusable codebook development process: a literature-informed preliminary taxonomy is refined through iterative coding of authentic transcripts in two phases — \"taxonomy development and refinement with inter-rater reliability (IRR) assessment\" — combining collaborative and independent coding rounds
title: Hybrid deductive–inductive codebook development with iterative expert coding and IRR

description: The article proposes a novel unsupervised clustering pipeline that \"combines the strengths of K-Means and HDBSCAN\" to uncover reasoning patterns in student essays without pre-defined labels.
title: Hybrid K-Means/HDBSCAN similarity-density clustering pipeline for unlabeled student essay analysis

description: A portable text-analysis pipeline combining Latent Dirichlet Allocation (k=8 topics on unigrams/bigrams) with sentence embeddings from the small multilingual encoder EmbeddingGemma-300M, projected via UMAP (cosine metric) and clustered with HDBSCAN.
title: Hybrid LDA–embedding clustering pipeline for short student-response analysis

description: The article's embedding model is fine-tuned with a hybrid objective combining Multi-Label Supervised Contrastive Loss (MulSupCon), which groups solutions sharing problem-type and correctness labels, with Multiple Negatives Ranking (MNR) loss, a retrieval-oriented ranking objective, weighted by a fac
title: Hybrid multi-label supervised-contrastive and multiple-negatives-ranking embedding method for performance-aware submission analytics

description: This approach uses the HyperOpt toolkit to automatically tailor Apprentice Learner agents to specific students.
title: HyperOpt-based tuning of Apprentice Learner agents

description: The report frames teacher and school performance measurement as a hypothesis-testing problem, in which a decision (for example, whether an educator's performance differs from the average) can be a true positive, false positive, true negative, or false negative.
title: Hypothesis-testing framework for computing error rates of value-added performance measurement systems

title: Hypothetical-population inferential method for estimating activity-based reinstruction effects
